name: sensorium-ts-probes
description: The recorder's own probe project: it records ITSELF under vitest and node --test, and check.mjs reads the spools back.

scripts.probe: SENSORIUM_PROBE_DIRECT=1 vitest run; node check.mjs vitest "$SENSORIUM_SPOOL" "$SENSORIUM_MANIFEST_DIR"
scripts.probe:nodetest: node --import ../src/register.mjs --test nodetest/async.probe.test.ts nodetest/ext.probe.test.mts nodetest/ext.probe.test.mjs nodetest/ext.probe.test.cjs; node nodetest/controls.mjs; node check.mjs nodetest "$SENSORIUM_SPOOL" "$SENSORIUM_MANIFEST_DIR"
